description: This repository is a fork of embedpdf/embed-pdf-viewer. Renovate reads only the files the fork owns, listed in includePaths; everything else, including package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and the upstream workflows, changes only through upstream syncs.

customManagers.description: Tool pins marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: pnpm must equal packageManager in package.json, which upstream owns.
The image's Node base and mise.toml must move together; check-pins.py enforces it.
A new Node major line is a decision, not a routine bump.
wasm-bindgen-cli must equal the wasm-bindgen crate pin in crates/epdf-web/Cargo.toml.
The .NET SDK pin lives in global.json, the Dockerfile and release-dotnet.yml, with a SHA-512 per archive.
Pins with checksums beside them: Renovate cannot compute those, so it asks first and the PR needs them filled in by hand.
prBodyNotes: This pin has checksums Renovate cannot update. Fill them in from the upstream release, along with the other files `.devcontainer/check-pins.py` names; the `Development image pins` check fails until they match the published values.
